title: Format page
description: Lathe's record format, in the wiki card over the stage (`?page=format`): how records are kept, then an index of the kinds by stage, the relations and the checks by severity.

title: Kind page
description: What the reference says about one kind, its columns included, in the wiki card over the stage (`?page=format/kinds/<kind>`).

title: Check page
description: One check, in the wiki card over the stage (`?page=format/checks/<check>`), on the Check aggregate's own page: a check with a row, Lathe's or the product's own, read whole through the aggregate's own query (GET /api/check/get-check), with its severity, explanation, query, the kinds it concerns and the problems it reports now; a check the engine reports itself, from the format reference. A product's own check is changed through the aggregate's own commands; Lathe's are read-only.

title: Changes panel
description: Tools › Changes, a panel over the stage (`?panel=changes` on any focus): the space's records changed since the Changes baseline, newest first, by record, each a card with what changed and when, under the baseline picker. Selecting one focuses its record on the stage.

title: Use case page
description: A record of a use case (the use case, a UC requirement, a flow, a step or a test) on its aggregate's own page: the use case read whole through the Use case aggregate's own query (GET /api/use-case/get-use-case), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Business outcome page
description: A business outcome on its aggregate's own page: the outcome read through the Business outcome aggregate's own query (GET /api/business-outcome/get-business-outcome), its statement, measure, target and how it is measured outside the code, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Extension record page
description: A record of a kind a product declares as its own, on the Extension record aggregate's own page: the record read through the aggregate's own query (GET /api/extension-record/get-extension-record), its declared fields with its lead text first, the links it starts by relation and the packages it uses, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands, each form built from its kind's declaration. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Entry point page
description: An entry point on its aggregate's own page: the entry point read through the Entry point aggregate's own query (GET /api/entry-point/get-entry-point), what it does at start-up, its file, the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Tooling page
description: A tooling record on its aggregate's own page: the record read through the Tooling aggregate's own query (GET /api/tooling/get-tooling), its file, the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Domain records page
description: A record of a domain (the domain itself, a capability, a term, a domain service, its service or a test, a repository) on its aggregate's own page: the domain read whole through the Domain aggregate's own query (GET /api/domain/get-domain), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. The domain itself shows its wiki. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Test data set page
description: A test data set on its aggregate's own page: read through the Test data set aggregate's own query (GET /api/test-data-set/get-test-data-set), its setup, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Pattern page
description: A record of a pattern (the pattern, a rule or a rule test) on its aggregate's own page: the pattern read whole through the Pattern aggregate's own query (GET /api/pattern/get-pattern), what that record holds of it, who follows it (read through the Pattern following aggregate's own query, GET /api/pattern-following/list-followers, and changed through its commands) and each domain's standing per rule, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Standard page
description: A record of a standard (the standard, a rule or a rule test) on its aggregate's own page: the standard read whole through the Standard aggregate's own query (GET /api/standard/get-standard), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Table page
description: A record of a table on its aggregate's own page: the table read whole through the Table aggregate's own query (GET /api/table/get-table), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Specification page
description: A record of a specification, its predicate or its test on its aggregate's own page: the specification read whole through the Specification aggregate's own query (GET /api/specification/get-specification), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Value object page
description: A record of a value object, a constraint, its value type or a constraint test on its aggregate's own page: the value object read whole through the Value object aggregate's own query (GET /api/value-object/get-value-object), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Read model page
description: A record of a read model, a query, its projection, its reader or a query handler on its aggregate's own page: the read model read whole through the Read model aggregate's own query (GET /api/read-model/get-read-model), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: View page
description: A record of a view (the view, a view requirement or a view test) on its aggregate's own page: the view read whole through the View aggregate's own query (GET /api/view/get-view), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: UI component page
description: A UI component on its aggregate's own page: read whole through the UI component aggregate's own query (GET /api/ui-component/get-ui-component), its description and the packages it uses, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it, the views it renders and the standard rules it meets among them, is the Record page pattern's.

title: Endpoint page
description: A record of an endpoint (the endpoint, an API requirement, its endpoint handler or an endpoint test) on its aggregate's own page: the endpoint read whole through the Endpoint aggregate's own query (GET /api/endpoint/get-endpoint), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands, Move for the endpoint alone. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Integration page
description: A record of an integration (the integration, its adapter or an integration test) on its aggregate's own page: the integration read whole through the Integration aggregate's own query (GET /api/integration/get-integration), what that record holds of it, and the actions that change it through the aggregate's own commands. What every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's, with the flow steps that exchange with the integration and its outside system.

title: Checks panel
description: Tools › Checks, a panel over the stage (`?panel=checks` on any focus): every problem of the space's product, errors first, grouped by check, then the workspace's under Workspace and the recorded exceptions. Selecting a problem focuses its record on the stage.

title: Product page
description: A product, and each of its open questions and interfaces, on the Product aggregate's own page at its ID, read through the aggregate's own query (GET /api/product/get-product): a product's description, its business outcomes, its domains as cards with coverage bars (designed, built and proved) and tests by state, what it shares, its summary of what Lathe counts across it, its limits (read through the Product setting aggregate's own query, GET /api/product-setting/get-limits, and set through its command), its roles, interfaces, declared kinds and relations, its open questions and its problems; an open question's description, owner, place and what it is about; an interface's kind and the flows through it. The actions change them only through the Product aggregate's own commands; what every record's page shares around it is the Record page pattern's.

title: Workbench
description: The app's frame around every page: the stage behind it, the floating panels over it (the navigation, the tab panel with the page bar and the header strip, and the wiki card), tooltips, the keys and the announcer, and on a phone the top bar, the drawers and the sheets.

title: Appearance
description: A popover over the stage, anchored to its button at the foot of the nav (`?panel=appearance`): the mode choice and every theme, previewed live on the stage, with import and export; and the theme editor, a larger panel over the stage (`?panel=theme&theme=<id>`), for a theme of one's own.

title: Theme picker
description: The Color theme and Light, dark or system quick picks, which preview as they are arrowed.

title: Quick open
description: Quick find and the command palette as one overlay in the upper middle of the window: the current space's records by ID or title, with the highlighted one previewed on the stage, or, after a ">", every command that applies, with its keys.

title: Shortcuts sheet
description: Every shortcut grouped as Navigate, View, Graph and Lists, with a search and the override note.

title: Native menus
description: The desktop app's menu bar: the app menu, File, Edit, View, Window and Help.

title: Desktop title bar
description: The app's own 38 px bar in the desktop window: back and forward, the command center and the layout toggles.

title: Launch view
description: The shell color, the logo and "Opening <product>…" until the page has its specs.

title: Error page
description: The engine's message, with Retry, Open Another Folder and Reveal in Finder.

title: About window
description: The app's, the engine's and Electron's versions, with links to the repo and the record format.

title: Dock icon
description: Lathe's icon in the Dock, with its badge and its menu.

title: Nav
description: The left menu: with two or more products, a rail with one icon per product (each product a space), and a panel listing the current space's domains with their capabilities, headed by its name and icon. It holds the Go to button that opens quick find (LA-V64) and the stage folders.

title: Domain page
description: The domain's one page, at its ID: its description, its records grouped by stage, a search box, and the domain's coverage (designed, built and proved), gaps and problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the wiki card.

title: Record page
description: One record: its text fields rendered as Markdown, its part rows and other fields, parent and children, links out and in grouped by relation, and its problems.

title: Graph stage
description: The whole model as one map, shown on the Graph stage of an address and focused on that record (or a group of the graph's tree, at its address): laid out left to right in columns by depth in the parent/child tree, like a folder tree, every parent as tall as its children and every sibling in one column, children grouped by kind, each kind drawn in its own shape (a domain a hexagon). It draws the tree alone: a record's links to other branches are the Trace stage's and the wiki card's. The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth asks for in the open space the floating panels leave; every stage's toolbar floating at the top of that space holds the steps, Out, In and Frame, then the layout and depth switches and the kind filters, with a minimap and the camera's zoom and fit buttons at its corners and the stage's key bar along its bottom (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21).

title: ERD stage
description: One map of the whole product's entity-relationship diagram, laid out once per product and data change: each domain a region, its aggregates boundaries around their entities, and the relationships between them, across regions where they cross domains. Every focus navigates the map: what lies outside the focus's scope fades, the focus's box is picked out, and the camera glides to frame it in the open space the floating panels leave, under every stage's toolbar and camera, with every stage's key bar along its bottom (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21). It draws entities and their relationships only.

title: Focus page
description: One full-window stage, the Graph, the ERD or the Trace, switched in the page bar and named in the address, with everything else floating over it as frosted panels: the nav, the tab panel (the page bar, with the tabs in the desktop app, then the header strip naming the focus) and the wiki card with the focus's wiki page. The stage frames the focus in the open space the panels leave, and every stage has the same controls in the same places: a toolbar centered at the top of the open space, the camera's buttons at the frame's bottom left and the stage's key as a bar along the bottom (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21, LA-V96-R30).

title: Products picker
description: The space chooser at `/`: a card centered over the dimmed stage of the last product the Reader was in, or over an empty map on a first launch, with every product, its look and its number of domains.

title: Trace stage
description: What a product owes and how far it has come, drawn on the canvas as the Graph's Tree is, with its layout, renderer, camera, level of detail and walk: one tree per product, laid out once per product and data change by the Graph's own Tree layout, so each trace reads left to right from why to proof. The product holds its business outcomes, each holding the use cases of every capability serving it (the capability named on each use case's kind line, not drawn), then a Not under an outcome branch holding every obligation no outcome reaches, by domain, then an Untraced mark holding what no chain reaches. Below each use case or parent the record tree runs down to its obligations, and each obligation's chain runs on to its right by the chain's actual links (what designs it, builds it, proves it and the files they name), every gap a dashed box beside it. Every box is a real record, a gap, the Not under an outcome branch or the Untraced mark, never a folder. Focusing anything moves the camera to frame it and its children and fades the rest; Gaps only fades the complete branches; nothing ever re-lays out (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R19). Its toolbar and camera are every stage's (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21), with Gaps only as its own control, and its key is every stage's key bar. The table of the chains under the focus is its accessible layer, visually hidden under the canvas, and the whole stage on a phone.

title: Chat panel
description: The desktop app's conversation with the Owner's own Claude Code, floating at the right over the stage the full height of the window: its head names the session and opens the session picker and the help; the log holds the messages, Claude's answers as rich text with record links, tool rows, permission prompts and each turn's changed records; the composer at its foot sends, and becomes Stop while Claude works.
